entities.summary: Kathy Radzuweit is a German retired volleyball player, who was a member of the German Women's Team at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens, Greece. She played at the 2002 FIVB Volleyball Women's World Championship in Germany. On club level she played with Volley Cats Berlin.
